trap.label: recommend + that
trap.wrong: I recommend to use public transport.
trap.right: I recommend that people use public transport.
trap.why: Em português, "recomendo usar" aceita infinitivo. Em inglês formal, recommend that + sujeito + verbo base (sem -s).

opts: I suggest that she goes to home.
I suggest that she go home.
I suggest her to go home.

mcq.q: Complete: They recommend that every student **___** a copy.
Qual evita o erro de brasileiro?
opts: We advise that schools close early.
We advise schools to that close early.
We advise that schools to close early.
I recommend that he doesn't to drive.
I recommend that he not to drive.
I recommend that he not drive.

fix.wrong: I recommend to take the early train.
fix.right: I recommend taking the early train.
fix.why: Após recommend sem that, use -ing (ou that-clause).

fix.wrong: She suggested that he takes a break.
fix.right: She suggested that he take a break.

fix.wrong: They advise us to that apply early.
fix.right: They advise that we apply early.
fix.why: Escolha uma estrutura: advise that + sujeito + base.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com that: “I recommend taking a break.” (sujeito: he)
rewrite.answer: I recommend that he take a break.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com suggest that: “You should see a dentist.”
rewrite.answer: I suggest that you see a dentist.

rewrite.prompt: Passe para a negativa: “We recommend that she go.”
rewrite.answer: We recommend that she not go.
